subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 04, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - November 04, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

As we continue to move forward in our mission to create a user-friendly, community-driven Linux distribution based on Arch Linux, we're excited to share some recent updates and developments with you. Our team has been hard at work, and we're proud to announce that we've made significant progress on several fronts.

Firstly, we'd like to highlight the recent release of openSUSE Leap 16.1, which has been announced by the openSUSE project. This release brings together traditional and immutable systems, offering users a more streamlined and efficient experience. We're always keeping an eye on the latest developments in the Linux world, and we're excited to see how this release will impact the community.

In other news, Fedora Linux 45 has been released, featuring all editions, including Workstation, Server, and Cloud. This release includes a range of new features and improvements, and we're eager to see how our users will benefit from them. We're also keeping an eye on the security updates issued by AlmaLinux, which include fixes for various packages, including bind, firefox, and pipewire.

On the AcreetionOS front, we've been busy making improvements to our distribution. One of the recent commits has fixed a postinstall.sh silently failing on pwfeedback sudoers edit in AcreetionOS-Xlibre. We're committed to ensuring that our users have a seamless experience, and we're working hard to address any issues that may arise.

We've also been working on some exciting new features, including a Wayland edition gate, which will allow users to easily switch between Wayland and X11. This is just one of the many features we're working on to enhance the AcreetionOS experience.

In addition to these updates, we've also been busy updating our documentation and guides. Our intelligence sync commit has ensured that our newsletter, archive, wiki guides, and feed are all up-to-date and accurate. We're committed to providing our users with the best possible experience, and we're working hard to ensure that our documentation is comprehensive and easy to use.

We're also excited to announce that we've merged a pull request that adds support for the Wayland edition gate. This is a significant step forward for AcreetionOS, and we're confident that it will enhance the user experience.

As always, we're grateful for the support of our community. Your feedback and contributions are invaluable to us, and we're committed to listening to your needs and addressing any issues that may arise. If you have any questions or suggestions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord server or through our contact form.

Finally, we'd like to thank our developers, Darren and Natalie, for their tireless efforts in making AcreetionOS the best it can be. Their dedication and expertise are the driving force behind our project, and we're grateful for their hard work and commitment to our community.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're excited to see what the future holds for our project, and we're grateful for your support.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
